title: SNMP Switch Port Status
description: Switch interface admin/oper status from logs-snmp.topology-default (Track B)

data_source.query: FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.type == "switch" AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL port_key = CONCAT(host.name, ":", interface.name) | STATS latest = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY port_key | WHERE latest == "up" | STATS Ports_Up = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.type == "switch" AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL port_key = CONCAT(host.name, ":", interface.name) | STATS latest = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY port_key | WHERE latest == "down" | STATS Ports_Down = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.type == "switch" AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL port_key = CONCAT(host.name, ":", interface.name) | STATS latest = LAST(interface.status.admin, @timestamp) BY port_key | WHERE latest == "down" | STATS Admin_Down = COUNT(*)
FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.type == "switch" AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS Switches = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name)

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.type == "switch" AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL port_key = CONCAT(host.name, ":", interface.name) | STATS oper = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY port_key | STATS ports = COUNT(*) BY oper

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.type == "switch" AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS oper = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY host.name, interface.name | WHERE oper == "down" | STATS down_ports = COUNT(*) BY host.name | SORT down_ports DESC

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.name == "hq-access-sw-03" AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS admin = LAST(interface.status.admin, @timestamp), oper = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY interface.name | SORT interface.name

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.type == "switch" AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS admin = LAST(interface.status.admin, @timestamp), oper = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY network.site, host.name, interface.name | WHERE oper == "down" | SORT network.site, host.name, interface.name
